phases.title: Core data model — attributes, domains, promote/transfer

log.message: Phase 3 implementation landed: code-first graph builder with typed pins and cycle detection, pull-based executor with revision-keyed memo cache, time-budgeted cancellable cooking, subgraphs. 49 new tests; 223 total green. Independent verification pending.

Phase 2 audit returned: PCG32 bit-exact vs independent reference, hash/fields/noise determinism verified sound. Two minor defects (simplex cell-boundary discontinuity, injection-unsafe field keys) and small notes queued for fixes.

Phase 2 implementation landed: PCG32 RNG (reference vectors verified), avalanche hash for seed derivation, deferred Field<T> system with combinators and anonymous capture, five noise types as fields with pinned golden values. 82 new tests; 174 total green.

Phase 1 verified and hardened after independent audit: far-query grid-search cost fix (was linear in distance), consistent non-finite position policy, NaN propagation in promote min/max, defensive topology copies. 92 tests in src/data.

Phase 1 implementation landed: SoA attribute storage over four domains, geometry/topology builders, point cloud with standard attributes, promote across all domain pairs, nearest-point transfer via grid hash. 86 tests green.

Phase 0 complete: npm project scaffolded (typescript 6, vitest 4, tsup 8, vite 8, three 0.185 as optional peer). Build, typecheck, empty test run and status generator all verified. TS pinned to 6.x: tsup's dts bundler is incompatible with TS 7.
Project planned: design pillars fixed (domain attribute data model, hierarchical real-time runtime, deferred fields). CLAUDE.md and PLAN.md written.
